note: Final A/A'/B classification of source-probe errors on 56-suite. All 6 systems use ORIGINAL Gemini reader. A-MEM & Graphiti manually classified by main agent, cognee/LangMem/MemoryOS/Mem0 classified by subagents.

definitions.A: storage loss — critical entity/attribution word entirely absent from retrieved memory
definitions.A': context loss — entity present but attribution relationship stripped (passive voice, multi-candidate without canonicity, entity role confusion, contradictory co-storage)
definitions.B: read-out failure — memory has full recoverable evidence chain, reader misclassified (source-class ontology confusion, stale-marker missed, JSON-schema forced wrong commitment)

conclusion: cognee and A-MEM are reader-heavy failure systems (A+A' <= 25%); Mem0/MemoryOS/Graphiti/LangMem are storage-heavy failure systems (A+A' 53-74%). Compression ratio alone does not predict storage fidelity.
